checks.reason: AGENTS.md requires explicit test consent; implementation and deployment authorization does not include tests.

bridge.style: matte bowstring side trusses and masonry abutments

map.terrain: plain matte vertex colors; no grass texture/noise

railway.ballast: sloped matte shoulders; absent on bridge

atmosphereFixes: relative vertex grass tint with separate bank/bed paint
diorama.rendering: AgX exposure 1.06, directional daylight 3.15, hemisphere 1.0, fill 0.35; Auto default with sun shadows; High MSAA 4x and GTAO 60% resolution capped at 1280 pixels, radius 1.2m, intensity 0.45; Light direct rendering

traffic.departure: manual at both stations; optional auto dwell
traffic.interlocking: conservative full-journey lane reservations; crossovers lock both lanes

trackPlan.access: Player selects approach J2 and south target J4; route traverses crossover before loop fork

vegetation.active: original diorama trees, shrubs, grass and flowers
vegetation.placement: deterministic; excludes river, track, station and house footprints
